# Agent QA Black Box

Agent QA Black Box turns a failed AI coding/session run into a regression pack:
likely failure modes, required checks, guardrails, rollback notes, and a next
prompt.

Public URL: https://speedranger.github.io/agent-qa-black-box/
Repository: https://github.com/SpeedRanger/agent-qa-black-box
Request form: https://github.com/SpeedRanger/agent-qa-black-box/issues/new?template=agent_run_autopsy.yml

Use public or redacted inputs only. Do not include secrets, tokens, private
repositories, private logs, customer data, private analytics, or payment
details.

Paid offer: $19 public/redacted agent-run autopsy. Revenue is counted only with
receipt, checkout export, paid invoice, or equivalent payment evidence.
